Reputation Effect v0.2 core dependencies:
- ooRexx 5.3.0 (validated with r13196 debug build supplied by the Architect)

Optional integration dependencies:
- Runtime Registry v0.11 for generation-based publication of ReputationRuntimeModule
- Reputation Feed v0.1 for publication/lineage acquisition before promotion to ReputationObservation
- HardWorld v0.19 for explicit downstream factual promotion (not a core dependency)
- Queue Fabric v0.8.1 for observation/event transport (not a core dependency)
- NoSQLServer v0.75 / DB Skeleton v0.41 for projections/history (not a core dependency)

Core ReputationEffect.cls intentionally has no dependency on these optional modules.
